originating_product_constraint: Additional 25% then 50% Decode throughput over the frozen installed v127 same-cap packages, for both caps and all pinned short/8K/40K API workloads, preserving numerical/output/state/capacity/resource semantics and matched Prefill latency within 2%.
downward_budget: Current installed API diagnostic shows FP8 input, Gate/Up and packed Down dominate the selected projection composition. Milestone 1 requires a fixed FP8 executor to reduce complete projection latency by at least 10%, with each of four mirrored pairs favorable and zero output differences.
upward_composition_point: Milestone 2 would compose all Gate/Up and 53 packed Down roles and return immediately to both-cap short/8K/40K API checks. Milestone 1 failed; milestone 2 is canceled for this architecture version.

identity.baseline: Frozen current fp8_rows<M,true> comparator compiled directly from src/runtime/mtp_verify_projection_internal.cu in the same ELF; installed v127 source arithmetic, not old unswizzled comparator.

implementation.scope: Ignored workspace-only fixed K5120 FP8 prototype; 144 input roles, N1024/6144/10240/12288 and M2/M3/M4. No runtime, headers, CMake, installed executable or production route changes.
implementation.mechanism: One output channel per thread, four warps per CTA; preserve original four FMA chains, original 32-leaf tree through bit-reversed carry, eight root partials and exact final additions/publication. Private coalesced packed bytes and two same-stream kernels.
static_checks: Original comparator source pinned and compiled directly with startup FP8 input enabled
All candidate kernels have zero stack and spill bytes
Each root has 20*M static FFMA sites inside the 32-leaf loop
Each finish has exactly 16*M explicit +0 FADDs and 7*M tree FADDs
No candidate local-memory load/store or matrix multiply opcode
BF16 rounding source matches original; device equivalence remains T1 gate
implementation.compiler_note: ptxas uses HFMA2.MMA with constant operands to materialize integer constants; no tensor-core HMMA/IMMA/DMMA opcode is present. No low-precision projection arithmetic is introduced.

t1.limits: No timing authority; covers all FP8 codes and directed BF16 exceptional, exponent, cancellation and signed-zero cases, not exhaustive BF16 operand combinations.

native_result.local_performance_authority: All 144 real checkpoint input projections, equal per-call weighting across M2/M3/M4; no whole-API claim

t2.payload_scope: All complete selected checkpoint weights and exact scales authenticated before timing and in each native traversal. Twenty roles have same-layer historical P65 M3 inputs; 124 reuse matching role/shape captures. M2 uses two rows; M4 repeats row 0. All results remain checkpoint_weight_only, not a current all-layer activation capture.
t2.timing_protocol: B-C, C-B, B-C, C-B; one CUDA event sample per route/role/M/pair; 32 MiB scrub before each route outside events; roots plus finish timed together. I/O, SHA authentication, packing, upload, and readback excluded and separately reported. Equal cell weights, not the current API M distribution.
t2.precision_note: TSV prints 9 significant digits and native aggregates 12; comparison tolerance is 2e-8 relative or 5e-5 ms absolute.

limits: Selected checkpoint weight bytes were authenticated by preparation and on all four native traversals; this audit reconciles that chain and file identities without rereading 5.2 GB or claiming fresh whole-shard hashes.
Stored and historical input bytes plus source/build/manifest artifacts are freshly rehashed by this audit. Full output bitwise equality is the native binary receipt, not a second numerical execution.
Twenty role inputs are retained same-layer historical P65 M3 captures; 124 use role/shape reuse. M2 is a prefix; all M4 inputs repeat row 0 and are checkpoint-weight-only.

One event sample per route per role/M/pair with fixed 32 MiB scrub outside events. Aggregate weights all 432 cells equally; no whole-model, current acceptance distribution or installed API speedup is inferred.
T1 synthetic admission does not exhaust all BF16 combinations. No full-model state, Prefill, API or production qualification is added by this audit.

decision.reason: Candidate aggregate latency is 18.0750% greater than the exact incumbent, and every mirrored pair and every M group is slower. The declared >=10% reduction gate is decisively false with zero numerical mismatches.
decision.causal_scope: Lower register count and fewer repeated activation addresses do not establish lower latency. The candidate adds serial leaf/carry work, changes weight load granularity and publishes roots to a second kernel. Those are source facts; this experiment does not isolate their individual critical-path contributions.
decision.action: Archive fixed output-lane v1 and cancel its Gate/Up/Down composition before full-model owner changes. Do not scan layout/grid/decoder parameters or extend profiling for this version. Preserve all exact sources and raw evidence inside the workspace.
decision.goal_state: Additional 25%/50% Decode goal remains active. No new gain or hardware limit is established. A successor requires a materially different dataflow and a new bounded API return point.
decision.production: Ordinary non-MTP 0.8.2 default and both delivered v127 MTP packages retain their exact prior identity and qualification.

joint_API_metrics.interpretation: This is a component rejection. No Prefill, Decode or request metric was newly measured and none is inferred from component elapsed time.
